bouts.anthony-wint-lucas-armand: Not much to say, Wint is strong and athletic, Armand we learned nothing.
bouts.ateba-gautier-roman-kopylov: Always loved Roman, just a hit or miss guy. Too much for Ateba at this stage of his career, despite Ateba's clear physical gifts, he looked stiff against a much smoother striker. Roman looked pretty scared until he started landing and realized he was likely much better as a fighter just physically outmatched. Ateba needs to grow from this hopefully, but the chin may be a little suspect.
bouts.court-mcgee-eric-nolan: Right for McGee to retire. Nolan slow, unathletic, but has some power.
bouts.damian-pinas-andrey-pulyaev: Pinas has scary power and big hands, Andrey should be cut.
bouts.deiveson-figueiredo-payton-talbott: Fig should retire, Payton looks good as always, need to see him in a real fight against a younger top fighter though.
bouts.imanol-rodri-guez-alden-coria: Imanol is fast and mean. He wants to hurt people out there. Alden is a technician, Imanol had no interest in letting this be a point fighting match and overwhelmed Alden.
bouts.jacobe-smith-bruce-whitehead: Not much here, Smith has some exceptional ground and pound, TBD on chin, stamina. No clue on Bruce, just could not see enough.
bouts.johnny-walker-mick-parkin: Walker will get KO'd at HW, but his speed and athleticism will give some guys problems. Mick Parkin is just so slow, will be able to beat lower level guys but speed becomes a huge problem.
bouts.king-green-esteban-ribovics: Green looked good until he got caught with another long combo. Ribovics looked fine, but not too impressed.
bouts.marcus-mcghee-anthony-romero: Marcus still hits hard, Romero looked pretty decent, TBD on Romero's chin durability.
bouts.marvin-vettori-ismail-naurdiev: Marvin's chin will fail soon. Ismail had a strong round, but gassed a bit and was still hittable, should have put Marvin away.
bouts.nata-lia-silva-wang-cong: I don't know, boring, do not really care.
bouts.rafael-dos-anjos-alexander-hernandez: RDA looked strong early but he's pretty much done. Alexander pretty much just same as he always is.
bouts.roberto-soldic-khaos-williams: Soldic looked hittable, Williams should be done fighting.

card: Overall, I think you did well. The card had many many early finishes, as you noted, this is not the norm, so it will likely end up appearing somewhat anomalous.
